purpose: Document first-party City of Pittsburgh GIS discovery and bounded anonymous Allegheny County parcel-geometry access for Pittsburgh.
assessment: The City of Pittsburgh GIS hub and linked Allegheny County DCS-GIS OPENDATA Parcels ArcGIS service provide a verified public cadastral source for Pittsburgh. One safe-ID polygon was retained as a bounded sample; this does not establish citywide completeness or production integration.
registryAssessment: Local parcel coverage was verified through the county GIS custodian: one exact-point parcel in Pittsburgh returned PIN 0013G00229000000 / map-block-lot 13-G-229. The service is countywide rather than a separately identified City-only cadastral registry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: City GIS page identifies the Department of Innovation & Performance GIS/Mapping hub as the authoritative city GIS source and links public mapping resources.
City interactive-apps page lists public mapping applications and identifies the City's GIS team; current page was fetched directly.
First-party Allegheny County DCS-GIS OPENDATA Parcels MapServer describes the public parcel layer, polygon geometry, native CRS WKID 102729, and supported query formats.
Parcel layer schema identifies PIN and MAPBLOCKLOT fields and polygon geometry; source layer metadata was fetched directly.
Anonymous GET with a point geometry, safe outFields PIN/MAPBLOCKLOT, returnGeometry=true, and outSR=4326 returned one GeoJSON polygon.

searchQueries.query: Pittsburgh official cadastral parcel map GIS Allegheny County parcel viewer API
searchQueries.result: Found official City GIS pages and the county DCS-GIS OPENDATA Parcels service; exact-point query succeeded.

searchQueries.query: Pittsburgh Pennsylvania official parcel map GIS property parcels Allegheny County
searchQueries.result: Second first-party discovery wording confirmed the City GIS interactive-app page and county parcel layer; no separate non-English local administrative language applies.

attempts.result: Fetched current City GIS interactive-app page; page exposes ArcGIS-hosted public apps and links to official map resources.
Fetched layer metadata; polygon layer uses native WKID 102729 / latest WKID 2272 and exposes PIN, MAPBLOCKLOT, and OBJECTID among source fields.

attempts.requestParameters: f=geojson; geometry=-79.9703261647027,40.4196878479719; geometryType=esriGeometryPoint; inSR=4326; spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; outFields=PIN,MAPBLOCKLOT; returnGeometry=true; outSR=4326
attempts.result: Returned one Feature with Polygon geometry and safe parcel fields PIN=0013G00229000000 and MAPBLOCKLOT=13-G-229.

nativeFieldMapping.retainedIdentityProvenance: PIN field returned by the county parcel layer; not an internal synthetic row number. MAPBLOCKLOT 13-G-229 was observed only as source evidence and is not retained in GeoJSON properties.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Returned one polygon for the exact WUP point; no coordinate shift was used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Allegheny County DCS-GIS public parcel layer covers individual properties in Allegheny County, including Pittsburgh.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One anonymous exact-coordinate parcel feature in Pittsburgh was verified; schema, source CRS, safe ID, and polygon geometry were observed.

remainingUncertainty: One exact-point sample cannot prove citywide completeness, update cadence, boundary alignment, or long-term endpoint reliability. The source layer metadata exposes additional fields, but none were retained; owner/address/title/tax/personal fields were not requested.
runtimeAssessment: held; no adapter admission or source integration implied
